sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('9354958c-e997-41c8-8605-23f0a58993c0', '23395673-116d-4a8e-b0ce-59f9ca5b3daf') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
